senses.gloss:
ITA-8.3.31 vāṭyaḥ वाट्यः
Fried barley porridge
A type of food preparation made from fried barley.

ITA-8.3.49 vāṭyamaṇḍaḥ वाट्यमण्डः
Liquid portion of porridge prepared with fried barley
The liquid portion of food preparations made from fried barley and consisting of one part fried barley and 14 parts water.
